major_events: In [第1163章 逼迫], South Palace family Ancestor Saint "Qingsheng" Nan Gong Sadness coerces Fang Han into returning the Heartbroken Bow and Lovelorn Arrow.
In [第1164章 天君出现], the Will of Chaos Heavenly Monarch descends to protect Fang Han, forcing South Palace Sadness to back down and cancel the South Palace family grudge.
In [第1165章 返回突破], Fang Han assists Xu Muyun in breaking through to the Ancestor Immortal stage and receives Saint Buddha Lamp Oil as a gift.
In [第1167章 狠狠羞辱], Fang Han returns to Yuhua Sect and publicly defeats and humiliates Saint Son Xiang Yizhen in a duel, forcing him to kneel.

In [第1173章 水月洞天书库], Fang Han uses his projection and the Epoch Divine Fist with ten-fold combat power to defeat Chen Zhenhua (Heart Emperor Saint Son) and transcribes ancient books in the library to expand his Epoch Book.

In [第1183章 强中自有强中手], Fang Han opens a spatial portal to remote-strike and injure elements from the Dark Emperor Palace while fending off combined attacks from the Sun Temple, Yan family, and Heart Emperor Palace.

In [第1193章 狞皇], Fang Han clashes with Little Stone Emperor Song Tengfei, who flees using the Monument of Deification, leading Fang Han to seek high-grade upgrades for his Thirty-Three Heavens Treasures.
In [第1203章 电母好友], Fang Han forms an alliance with Little Rain Emperor Xia Zhiqi by using a bit of Minor Destiny Art to gain her interest.
In [第1209章 小斧皇], Fang Han rescues Little Axe Emperor Xuan Yuanpo from a horde of Ruyi Heavenly Demons to secure another ally.

In [第1213章 一滴鲜血], Fang Han suppresses Yuhua Sect Saint Sons (Zhu Chongyang, Wan Xi'an, Hua Zhentian) using the Heavenly Unity realm, and extracts a drop of blood from Hua Zhentian to calculate the link between Hua Tianjun and Hua Tiandu.
In [第1223章 探索洞窟], Fang Han and his allies enter the deep devil caves where Song Tengfei fled to prevent him from refining the sealed clone of devil Saint Cang Sheng.
In [第1233章 救赎之山], Song Tengfei plots with other Taiyi Sect Saint Sons and the four small emperors to defeat Fang Han, while Fan Qi Wang warns them of Fang Han's combat power.

In [第1243章 以一敌二], Fang Han engages in a fierce battle against both Song Tengfei and Martial Tyrant Huangfu Fei simultaneously, using the Ghost Martial Saint Map combined with God Race civilization history.
In [第1253章 决策高层], Palm Master Yu Huang presents South Palace Sadness's gift of Saint-grade Dan gas from the Yuan Dan Patriarch to Fang Han, shocking the elders.
In [第1263章 异界高手], Fang Han encounters and destroys invading Barbarian armies, including their warrior Kuka-ka, and sacrifices them using the Great Sacrificial Art.

In [第1273章 吞吃圣人], Fang Han uses the Sky Zen Buddha Emperor corpse to capture and devour three ancient Saints (Bao Sheng, Bei Sheng, Huan Sheng), utilizing their Treasure Qi to upgrade his Legendary Staff, Eight 部 Floating Pagoda, and Yellow Spring Map to the Peak stage.
In [第1282章 阴谋来了], Fang Han breaks through to the Saint stage and warns Yu Huang of a conspiracy by the Hua family elders using the Minor Destiny Art.
In [第1192章 血祭皇者（下）], Fang Han sacrifices six Sovereign-stage experts (including the five elders of the Hua Family and Lie Huang) to upgrade his Eight 部 Floating Pagoda to the King-grade stage.
In [第1293章 亲手炼制王品仙器], Fang Han defeats and refines Dark Emperor of the Dark Emperor Palace inside the Eight 部 Floating Pagoda.
In [第1302章 到达天庭], Fang Han and Yu Huang arrive at the Heavenly Court to participate in the Heavenly Court genius tournament.
In [第1312章 又见挑衅], Fang Han is provoked by the Heavenly Court's Divine Prison Law Enforcement Disciples, and the voice of Thunder Emperor Heavenly Monarch acknowledges the conflict.
In [第1322章 十招神拳], various factions plan to assassinate Fang Han during the Genius Tournament.
In [第1332章 法界无上法], Fang Han clashing with Jun Cangsheng, a reincarnated Heavenly Monarch, who targets the Totem Canister.
In [第1342章 天庭征讨大军], Fang Han is drafted into the Crusade Army led by Ju Ling Huang to fight the invading Barbarians.
In [第1352章 天君一指（中）], Fang Han unleashes the Totem Canister to slaughter Barbarians and strengthen his treasures.
In [第1362章 神威无量], Fang Han enters the Heavenly Court treasury, steals the Decree of Eternal Heavenly Monarch talisman, and searches for Creation Divine Artifact chunks.
In [第1372章 翡翠天主（上）], Fang Han encounters Truth Sacred Land disciples trying to exploit the Heavenly Court's crisis.
In [第1382章 消除隐患], Fang Han refines the Judgement Spear and stores Heavenly Meridian Qi via the Truth Gourd.
In [第1392章 建立纪元门（下）], Fang Han establishes the Epoch Gate, which is recorded in the Truth Sacred Land's Heavenly Monarch Candidate Hall.
character_state_transitions: Fang Han: Ancestor Immortal in [第1163章 逼迫] -> Saint stage cultivator in [第1282章 阴谋来了] after devouring three ancient Saints and cultivating.
Xu Muyun: Half-step Ancestor Immortal in [第1163章 逼迫] -> Full Ancestor Immortal in [第1165章 返回突破] after receiving assistance and Saint Buddha Lamp Oil from Fang Han.
Xiang Yizhen: Arrogant Saint Son boasting of black night powers in [第1166章 嚣张三人组] -> Defeated, kneeling, and humiliated rival in [第1167章 狠狠羞辱].
Chen Zhenhua: Domineering senior Saint Son of Yuhua Sect in [第1170章] -> Defeated rival whose Three Yang One Qi True Heaven Yuan Spirit is suppressed by Fang Han's projection in [第1173章 水月洞天书库].

Song Tengfei: Reincarnation of the Monument of Deification seeking to kill all Saint Sons in [第1193章 狞皇] -> Heavily injured fugitive fleeing into the deep devil caves in [第1223章 探索洞窟] after clash with Fang Han.
Xia Zhiqi: Solitary and cautious reincarnation of Yu Huang in [第1203章 电母好友] -> Active battle ally and cooperative partner of Fang Han in [第1204章 生死棺材].
Xuan Yuanpo: Trapped cultivator surrounded by Ruyi Heavenly Demons in [第1208章] -> Rescued ally and cooperative partner of Fang Han in [第1209章 小斧皇].
Hua Zhentian: Arrogant leader of Yuhua Sect's Saint Sons in [第1213章 一滴鲜血] -> Terrified and fleeing observer who watches Fang Han devour three ancient Saints in [第1274章].

Three Ancient Saints (Bao Sheng, Bei Sheng, Huan Sheng): Powerful law-enforcement Saints of the Heavenly Court attempting to refine Fang Han in [第1272章 宝界] -> Devoured and refined source of Treasury Qi for Fang Han's weapons in [第1273章 吞吃圣人].

Five Grand Elders of the Hua Family (including Hua Wanchang) & Lie Huang: Confident Sovereign-stage experts plotting against Yu Huang and Fang Han in [第1282章 阴谋来了] -> Blood-sacrificed materials refined into Fang Han's Eight 部 Floating Pagoda in [第1192章 血祭皇者（下）].
Dark Emperor: Sovereign-stage expert and heir of Night Emperor Heavenly Monarch in [第1291章] -> Refined and absorbed material inside the Eight 部 Floating Pagoda in [第1293章 亲手炼制王品仙器].
Judgement Spear: Arrogant, independent Emperor-grade Immortal artifact plotting against Fang Han in [第1302章] -> Captured, refined, and suppressed power source inside Fang Han's body in [第1382章 消除隐患].

long_form_mechanisms.name: Epoch Book & Epoch Divine Fist (纪元之书与纪元神拳)
long_form_mechanisms.description: Fang Han's self-created cultivation path. The Epoch Book compiles the history, languages, and laws of various civilizations (like God, Buddha, Dragon, Barbarian) as pages, and the Epoch Divine Fist channels these civilizations' histories to deliver devastating strikes. [第1173章 水月洞天书库]

long_form_mechanisms.name: Three Yang One Qi True Heaven Yuan Spirit (三阳一气真天元神)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A supreme division technique where the cultivator uses powerful ancient devil bones, grievances, and flesh to refine three independent clones that share the same combat power as the main body. [第1173章 水月洞天书库]

long_form_mechanisms.name: Heavenly Unity Realm (天地一体的境界)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A supreme state of existence typically possessed only by Creation Divine Artifacts, where the cultivator's body resonance perfectly aligns with the environment, locking all local space and elements, preventing opponents from using space laws or environmental energy. [第1213章 一滴鲜血]

long_form_mechanisms.name: Supreme Ten Thousand Treasures Grand Sacred True Qi (至尊万宝大圣真罡)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A divine technique used by the three ancient Saints to communicate with the Treasure Realm and draw Treasury Qi, which is used as a universal substitute for rare materials to refine and upgrade Immortal weapons. [第1273章 吞吃圣人]

long_form_mechanisms.name: Minor Destiny Art (小宿命术)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A simplified version of the Great Destiny Art, which allows the user to burn their own lifespan to perform precise future predictions, summon ancient spirits, and manipulate fate. [第1282章 阴谋来了]

long_form_mechanisms.name: Blood Sacrifice of Emperors (血祭皇者)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A forbidden refining method where Sovereign-stage experts are killed and their entire bloodlines, rules, and life essence are refined into a weapon, transforming its material structure into crystal-divine-kingdom forms and upgrading it to King-grade. [第1192章 血祭皇者（下）]

long_form_mechanisms.name: Decree of Eternal Heavenly Monarch Talisman (永恒天君急急如律令符)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A supreme talisman hand-drawn by the Eternal Heavenly Monarch that contains the will of a Heavenly Monarch. It can neutralize tribulation forces and assist cultivators in breaking through major realm barriers. [第1362章 神威无量]

long_form_mechanisms.name: Truth Gourd & Heavenly Meridian Qi (真理葫芦与天脉元气)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A supreme artifact/technique from the Truth Sacred Land that allows the cultivator to store massive amounts of Heavenly Meridian Qi, enabling them to execute hundreds of high-multiplier combat strikes without running dry. [第1382章 消除隐患]

long_form_mechanisms.name: Totem Canister (图腾之罐)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A former Saint-grade Immortal artifact that is especially effective against the Barbarian race. It can swallow Barbarian commanders, refine their unique Barbarian God laws, and convert them into power to reinforce itself and the user's crystal kingdoms. [第1352章 天君一指（中）]

continuity_observations: The relationship between Dianmu Tianjun and the ancient Yu Huang is introduced via Xia Zhiqi in [第1202章 拜见] and [第1203章 电母好友], maintaining the long-term plot thread of Dianmu's pursuit of Destiny and her fall.

Fang Han's obsession with obtaining Hua Zhentian's blood in [第1213章 一滴鲜血] to calculate the link between Yuhua Sect's founder (Hua Tianjun) and his mortal rival (Hua Tiandu) is a persistent mystery running throughout the novel.
Little Stone Emperor Song Tengfei's origin as the reincarnated Monument of Deification is introduced in [第1193章 狞皇] and resolved during his defeat and pursuit into the devil caves in [第1223章 探索洞窟].
The corpse of the Sky Zen Buddha Emperor is used repeatedly as a key combat summon using Minor Destiny Art, notably in [第1272章 宝界] and [第1282章 阴谋来了].

The description of Minor Destiny Art as a precursor to Dianmu's legendary technique that challenged the Creation Immortal King is consistently referred to, especially in Xia Zhiqi's reactions in [第1204章 生死棺材].

The requirement of Creation Divine Artifact chunks for upgrading the Thirty-Three Heavens Treasures is maintained consistently; even devouring three Saints and utilizing Treasure Qi in [第1273章 吞吃圣人] cannot upgrade them, forcing Fang Han to seek chunks in the Heavenly Court treasury in [第1362章 神威无量].
Yu Huang's connection to the ancient Holy Temple is highlighted by Fang Han's prediction in [第1282章 阴谋来了] and developed through the conflict with the Hua family elders.
The source text displays a numbering error where [第1192章 血祭皇者（下）] appears immediately after [第1291章 血祭皇者（上）], which is a clear serialization continuity anomaly in the compilation.

The geopolitical split between the Truth Sacred Land (Truth Immortal King) and the Heavenly Court (Creation Immortal King) is introduced in [第1372章 翡翠天主（上）] and continues as a major background setting.
style_observations: Geniuses in this arc are systematically framed as reincarnations of ancient weapons, emperors, or friends of major figures (e.g. Song Tengfei as Monument of Deification [第1193章 狞皇], Xia Zhiqi as Yu Huang [第1203章 电母好友], Xuan Yuanpo as Axe Emperor [第1209章 小斧皇]), which adds historical weight to their talents.

The author frequently uses concrete multipliers (e.g., "ten-fold combat power" [第1173章], "fourteen-fold combat power" [第1204章], "three-hundred-fold combat power" [第1382章]) to quantify character breakthroughs and combat intensity.

Typographical errors in chapter numbering (such as the duplicate/misplaced Chapter 1192 after Chapter 1291) reflect the rapid, daily-update nature of web serialization without rigorous editorial revision.

Opponents consistently accuse the protagonist of being a "蚍蜉" (ant/gnat) or "insignificant" (e.g. Chen Zhenhua in [第1173章 水月洞天书库], the four small emperors in [第1233章 救赎之山], and Hua Zhentian in [第1274章]) only to be immediately crushed, creating a recurring rhythmic satisfaction for web readers.

The narrative heavily quantifies resource consumption during battles (e.g., burning thousands of years of lifespan, consuming King-grade veins in [第1209章 小斧皇]) to create a sense of mechanical cost and high stakes.

The story moves from Yuhua Sect to the ancient ruins (太古之墟), to the deep devil caves, to the Heavenly Court, and finally mentions the distant Truth Sacred Land [第1372章 翡翠天主（上）], expanding the spatial map to match the protagonist's rising level.

creation_family_evidence.author: 梦入神机 (Mengru Shenji)
key_concepts: 永生之门 (Gate of Eternal Life)
三十三天至宝 (Thirty-Three Heavens Treasures)
八部浮屠 (Eight 部 Floating Pagoda)
纪元之道 / 纪元之书 (Epoch Dao / Epoch Book)
天禅佛皇 (Sky Zen Buddha Emperor)
creation_family_evidence.stylistic_signature: Focuses on rapid cultivation breakthroughs, devouring/absorbing opponents to seize their laws and weapons, massive scales of battles involving billions of troops, and the search for the Gate of Eternal Life and its connection to Destiny.
creation_family_evidence.compilation_indicators: The chapter headers follow a standard format with Chinese numbers followed by a space and the title (e.g. "第1163章 逼迫", "第1392章 建立纪元门（下）"). The text includes double-byte indentations at paragraph starts and features a numbering anomaly where "第1192章" is inserted out of sequence after "第1291章", typical of web-serialized compilation releases.

originality_risks: Almost every major rival or ally is revealed to be a reincarnation of an ancient supreme figure or weapon (e.g., Little Stone Emperor as Monument of Deification [第1193章 狞皇], Little Rain Emperor as Yu Huang [第1203章 电母好友], Little Axe Emperor as Axe Emperor [第1209章 小斧皇]), which reduces character originality and makes the universe feel overly deterministic.

The protagonist's primary method of getting stronger is directly devouring or refining defeated enemies (e.g., swallowing the three ancient Saints in [第1273章 吞吃圣人], blood-sacrificing the Hua family elders and Lie Huang in [第1192章 血祭皇者（下）]), which can become a repetitive progression loop that simplifies character development to raw consumption.

The use of arbitrary and massive multipliers (e.g. 14-fold combat power, 33-fold combat power, 300-fold combat power in [第1382章 消除隐患]) can lead to power scaling inflation, where combat outcomes are decided by mathematical statements rather than tactical creativity.

Despite reaching the supreme realm of the Heavens, the conflict within the Yuhua Sect (internal betrayal by the Hua family and elders in [第1282章 阴谋来了]) mimics the standard low-level sect conflicts from the mortal realm, representing a repetitive narrative cycle.
